subject: Secure SDLC evidence request: code review sampling, ephemeral secrets, and rollback authorization
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@finservco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assessor@auditfirm.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Secure SDLC evidence request: code review sampling, secrets & rollback

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this. FinServCo is completing a SIG review and we need a small evidence package focused on your Secure SDLC controls. Specifically we are looking for the following artifacts (reasonable redactions OK):

- Code review: sample of 10 merged PRs from the last 6 months (author, reviewers, timestamps, approval comments).
- CI/CD controls: CI run IDs for those PRs, pipeline approval gates, and any deployment guard logs.
- Secrets management: proof of ephemeral credential usage (Vault lease/rotation logs) and KMS access audit for service accounts.
- Change/change-authorisation: emergency rollback approvals and the documented emergency rollback runbook entries used in the last 12 months.

Can you confirm you can produce a package by EOD Friday (2026-11-12)? If there are sensitive items, we can accept redacted PDFs and an index file describing redactions. Also let us know the primary contact for each artifact.

Appreciate it — this is a blocking item for our scheduler.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Security Operations — FinServCo
Attachment: none

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@finservco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request: code review sampling, secrets & rollback

Alex —

Thanks for the clarity. We can deliver a scoped package by EOD Friday (2026-11-12). Plan and owners below:

- Code review sampling (owner: Marcus Lin) — will provide a CSV with PR id, repo, author, reviewers, timestamps and approval excerpts. We will include 10 representative PRs across infra and product services.
- CI/CD controls (owner: Marcus Lin) — provide CI run IDs and pipeline approval gate logs; will include audit entries for deployment approvals.
- Secrets management (owner: Monica Patel) — provide Vault lease events, rotation timestamps and a KMS access audit export for service accounts. Sensitive values redacted.
- Emergency rollback & authorisations (owner: Rishi Malhotra) — provide the redacted approvals PDF and the runbook excerpt that documents who can authorize a rollback and the communication trail.

We will upload the artifacts to a shared Drive folder and send an index file with redaction notes. If you need additional provenance (commit SHAs signed by CI, SLSA build IDs), call that out now.

One question: for the emergency rollback approvals, FinServCo typically wants the approver identity and the exact timestamp. We can provide redacted signatures if needed; for legal/assurance you may need the approver name unredacted. Please confirm whether redacted approver names are acceptable or if you require full names.

I'll coordinate delivery.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@finservco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Secure SDLC evidence request: code review sampling, secrets & rollback

Team —

Attached is the initial evidence bundle. Summary below and attachments referenced as stubs (we uploaded originals to the Drive link in the cover index):

1) sdlc-code-review-sample.csv (text/csv, 14KB) — 10 PRs from May–Oct 2026 across repo: transformer-serving, orchestration, console. Columns: PR_ID, repo, author, reviewers, created_at, merged_at, approval_comments_excerpt. The CSV includes approval timestamps and reviewer handles; we redacted internal email addresses.

2) ci-cd-run-ids-202605-202611.csv (text/csv, 9KB) — CI run IDs mapped to PR_ID above and deployment run IDs. For gated pipelines we included approval events and approver ID (role-level, redacted to role e.g., "platform-approver").

3) kms-access-audit-2026Q3.csv (text/csv, 22KB) — exported Cloud KMS IAM audit for service accounts used by the inference runtime; columns: timestamp, principal, action, resource. We redacted exact service account emails but included principal role and truncated identifier.

4) emergency-rollback-approvals-redacted.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB) — consolidated redacted approvals for two rollback events in 2026. We included the approver role, exact UTC timestamp of approval, and the minimal context. Names are redacted per legal guidance; if you require unredacted approver names for attestations, please confirm and we'll follow our escalation process (requires a Data Processing Addendum amendment).

Index/manifest: sdlc-evidence-index.txt (plain text) — describes redactions and lists original locations (internal Drive paths).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSDLD-EVIDENCE (access: FinServCo reviewer link, expires in 30 days)
HubSpot record: HSPOT-83492 (requested evidence ticket)

Attachment: sdlc-code-review-sample.csv (text/csv, 14KB)
Attachment: ci-cd-run-ids-202605-202611.csv (text/csv, 9KB)
Attachment: kms-access-audit-2026Q3.csv (text/csv, 22KB)
Attachment: emergency-rollback-approvals-redacted.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)

Marcus
Senior Platform Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Park <alex.park@finservco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assessor@auditfirm.com
Date: 2026-11-12T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request: code review sampling, secrets & rollback

Irene / Marcus —

Thanks, this looks good and the manifest helps. A couple of follow-ups before we close the ticket:

1) For the emergency rollback approvals PDF — we can accept redacted names for public distribution, but FinServCo's internal audit requires that one named approver (the assigned on-call engineering manager) is unredacted for their compliance check. Can you confirm whether you can provide a redacted copy for external sharing and an unredacted copy under a secured transfer to our compliance mailbox (security-assessor@auditfirm.com) with an NDA handshake?

2) For the Vault lease/rotation proof: we need to confirm the rotation window for ephemeral leases attached to deployment jobs. The auditor asks for evidence that leases are rotated within 1 hour of issuance for short-lived tokens used by CI runners. If Monica can include the lease TTLs and one example lease rotation log (timestamped), that will complete the request.

If you can send the secured unredacted approver file and the Vault lease example by EOD Monday (2026-11-15) we'll mark the item as satisfied.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Alex Park
Security Operations — FinServCo
Attachment: none
